integration_policy: Original compatibility metadata and adapter logic. Use the installed pack's live node schemas and frontend-managed recording state as runtime authority. Do not copy or synthesize opaque frontend state.
major_capabilities: interactive 3D scene staging and graybox/blockout previz
human and car actor movement recording
natural-language SceneState preset generation through the scene-staging-builder skill
scene_state_rules: SceneState root type is cube_scene with a nodes array.
The upstream scene-staging-builder skill uses block and group nodes for generated staging geometry.
The viewport already has a floor at Y=0; do not create a floor block merely to represent ground.
X is left/right, Y is vertical, Z is depth; generated scenes should remain inside the documented 100x100m world bounds unless the live pack proves otherwise.
A non-rotated box resting on Y=0 normally has py=sy/2 because position is the box center.
Use spawn_point {px, py, pz, ry} when actor placement matters and place elevated spawn points on the supporting top surface.
Preserve stable ids and logical groups when editing existing SceneState JSON.

acting.motion_data_policy: frontend-managed recording state; do not fabricate by guessed serialization

directing.directing_data_policy: frontend-managed camera timeline state; do not fabricate by guessed serialization

workflow_rules: Use live /object_info schemas before changing sockets/widgets.
Use SceneNode for staging, ActingNode for movement recording, and DirectingNode for camera-cut previz.
Treat motion_data and directing_data as frontend-managed unless a validated structured edit path exists.
Use captured stage/video outputs as reference/previz assets for downstream image/video generation when useful.
Preserve original workflow and preset files before nontrivial edits.
runtime_authority: Live ComfyUI node schemas, installed presets, and the installed upstream frontend override this static knowledge when versions differ.
